title: dendranthema coronarium
intro: Dendranthema coronarium, commonly known as Chrysanthemum coronarium or crown daisy, is a flowering plant in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is native to the Mediterranean region and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Dendranthema coronarium include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
